name: tide-forecast
description: Coastal tide predictions with a theme-aware chart.

files.content:
Tides{location.label} {#if tide.events.length || tide.points.length}

{hovered ? 'Predicted water level' : isSample ? 'Example water level' : tide.observed ? 'Current water level' : tide.predicted !== null ? 'Predicted water level' : 'High/low predictions only'}

{#if displayedLevel === null}—{:else}{/if}{symbol}

{hovered ? 'Selected time' : tide.next ? tide.next.type === 'H' ? 'Rising toward high tide' : 'Falling toward low tide' : 'Tide outlook'}

{time(displayedTime)}{#each timeParts as part}{#if part.type === 'hour' || part.type === 'minute'}{:else}{part.value}{/if}{/each}

{#if chartData.length > 1} {#snippet children({ context })} {/snippet}
{time(chartData[0].time)}MLLW · {tide.points.length ? 'predicted curve' : 'extrema only'}{time(chartData.at(-1)!.time)}
{/if}
{#each [{ label: 'Previous', event: tide.previous }, { label: 'Next', event: tide.next }] as entry}

{entry.label} {entry.event ? (entry.event.type === 'H' ? 'high tide' : 'low tide') : 'tide'}

{entry.event ? time(entry.event.time) : 'Unavailable'}

{#if entry.event}

{height(Number(entry.event.height))} {symbol}

{/if}
{/each}
{#if type !== 'simple'}
{#each tide.events .filter((p) => tideTimestamp(p.time) > now) .slice(0, type === 'detailed' ? 6 : density === 'compact' ? 2 : 4) as event}
{event.type === 'H' ? 'High tide' : 'Low tide'}{dateTime(event)}{height(Number(event.height))} {symbol}
{/each}
{/if} {:else}

No tide predictions available.

{/if} {#if sourceLabel}

{sourceLabel}

{/if}

<script lang="ts">
 import IconPlaceholder from '$lib/components/icon-placeholder.svelte';
 import type { IconSet } from '$LIB$/data/types.js';
 let { name, class: className = 'size-5' }: { name: 'arrowUp' | 'arrowDown' | 'weather' | 'sun' | 'moon' | 'tide' | 'wind' | 'rain' | 'snow'; class?: string; iconSet?: IconSet } = $props();
</script>
{#if name === 'arrowUp'}
 <IconPlaceholder lucide="ArrowUpIcon" tabler="IconArrowUp" phosphor="ArrowUpIcon" hugeicons="ArrowUp02Icon" remixicon="RiArrowUpLine" class={className} aria-hidden="true" />
{:else if name === 'arrowDown'}
 <IconPlaceholder lucide="ArrowDownIcon" tabler="IconArrowDown" phosphor="ArrowDownIcon" hugeicons="ArrowDown02Icon" remixicon="RiArrowDownLine" class={className} aria-hidden="true" />
{:else if name === 'weather'}
 <IconPlaceholder lucide="CloudSunIcon" tabler="IconCloud" phosphor="CloudSunIcon" hugeicons="SunCloud02Icon" remixicon="RiCloudy2Line" class={className} aria-hidden="true" />
{:else if name === 'sun'}
 <IconPlaceholder lucide="SunIcon" tabler="IconSun" phosphor="SunIcon" hugeicons="Sun03Icon" remixicon="RiSunLine" class={className} aria-hidden="true" />
{:else if name === 'moon'}
 <IconPlaceholder lucide="MoonIcon" tabler="IconMoon" phosphor="MoonIcon" hugeicons="Moon02Icon" remixicon="RiMoonLine" class={className} aria-hidden="true" />
{:else if name === 'tide'}
 <IconPlaceholder lucide="WavesIcon" tabler="IconWavesElectricity" phosphor="WavesIcon" hugeicons="WaterfallUp01Icon" remixicon="RiWaterFlashLine" class={className} aria-hidden="true" />
{:else if name === 'wind'}
 <IconPlaceholder lucide="WindIcon" tabler="IconWind" phosphor="WindIcon" hugeicons="WindPower02Icon" remixicon="RiWindyLine" class={className} aria-hidden="true" />
{:else if name === 'rain'}
 <IconPlaceholder lucide="CloudRainIcon" tabler="IconCloudRain" phosphor="CloudRainIcon" hugeicons="CloudRainIcon" remixicon="RiRainyLine" class={className} aria-hidden="true" />
{:else if name === 'snow'}
 <IconPlaceholder lucide="SnowflakeIcon" tabler="IconSnowflake" phosphor="SnowflakeIcon" hugeicons="SnowIcon" remixicon="RiSnowyLine" class={className} aria-hidden="true" />
{/if}
